item.title: Scholarship application: missing documents
item.context_text: You've applied for a master's scholarship at a university abroad. A few weeks later the admissions office writes to say your application is incomplete, and the deadline is close.
item.objective_text: Find out exactly what is missing, solve the problem with your reference, and keep the admissions office informed.
item.target_grammar: polite indirect questions (Could you let me know whether… I was wondering if…)
item.cultural_note: Admissions offices deal with thousands of files. A short, well-organised email that answers each point in turn, with the applicant's full name and reference number, gets dealt with faster.
success_conditions: Identify both missing documents, the real deadline and the translation rule
Understand why the reference letter is delayed
Write to the office explaining your actions and asking a precise question
Summarise your progress clearly on the phone

children.title: Read the admissions email
children.instructions: Read the email from the admissions office. Then answer the questions.
children.prompt_text:
Dear applicant,
Thank you for applying for the Global Futures Scholarship. Your file is currently incomplete. We have not yet received:
1. An official English translation of your bachelor's diploma (the copy you uploaded is in Uzbek only).
2. Your second reference letter.
Please note that the scholarship committee meets on 15 March, and files that are still incomplete on 1 March will not be considered this year. Translations must be certified by a notary or an official translation agency; translations made by applicants themselves cannot be accepted.
Kind regards,
Admissions Office

questions.prompt: Why is the diploma not accepted?
questions.explanation: "The copy you uploaded is in Uzbek only."

questions.prompt: By when must your file be complete?
questions.explanation: "Files that are still incomplete on 1 March will not be considered." 15 March is the committee meeting.

options: One certified by a notary or an official agency
Any translation signed by a teacher
questions.explanation: "Translations must be certified by a notary or an official translation agency."

children.title: Listen to your referee
children.instructions: Your former professor, who is writing your second reference, leaves you a voice message. Listen and answer the questions.
children.prompt_text: Hello, it's Professor Nazarova. I'm so sorry, I got your reminder about the reference. I've been at a conference and only got back yesterday. The thing is, the university's system keeps rejecting my upload. It says the file is too large. Could you ask the admissions office whether I can email it to them directly instead? I can have it finished by Friday, so there should still be plenty of time.

options: The system rejects the file because it is too large
The professor has forgotten her password
questions.explanation: "The university's system keeps rejecting my upload. It says the file is too large."

questions.prompt: What does the professor ask you to do?
options: Ask whether she can email the letter directly
questions.explanation: "Could you ask the admissions office whether I can email it to them directly instead?"

children.title: Write to the admissions office
children.instructions: Write to the admissions office. Say what you are doing about the translation, explain the problem with the reference letter, and ask your question about it. Show that you are aware of the deadline.
children.prompt_text:
To: Admissions Office
Subject: Global Futures Scholarship — incomplete file
children.goal: Answer each point of the office's email clearly and ask one precise question.

points.label: say what you are doing about the translation
ask whether it can be emailed

children.model_answer:
Dear Admissions Office,
Thank you for letting me know that my file is incomplete. I have already sent my diploma to an official translation agency, and the certified English translation will be uploaded by Wednesday. Regarding my second reference, Professor Nazarova has written the letter, but your system rejects her upload because the file is too large. Would it be possible for her to email it to you directly? She can send it by Friday, well before the 1 March deadline.
Kind regards,
Aziz Tursunov (Applicant ID 20417)

children.title: Update the admissions officer
children.instructions: Later that week an admissions officer phones you. Summarise your progress: what is done, what is still pending, and when everything will be complete.
children.prompt_text: Officer: Hi, I'm just checking where you are with the missing documents.
children.goal: Give a clear status update on both documents with a completion date.

points.label: say when it will be complete

children.model_answer: Thanks for calling. The certified translation of my diploma was uploaded yesterday, so that part is done. My second reference letter is still pending: Professor Nazarova is emailing it to you directly on Friday, as you agreed. So everything should be complete well before the first of March.
